rationale: The solutions are essentially identical: the same digit switch, the same overflow pre-check, the same sentinel errors and the same HandleErrors mapping. The only real difference is that A writes the bound as the magic literal 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, while B uses the named math.MaxInt64. The named constant is more readable and less error-prone. B's variable name value is also a little clearer than out. Otherwise they are equally clean.
